## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (typecheck, `claude plugin validate --strict`, `claude plugin test`, README up to date)
- [ ] New mods: the folder has `README.md`, tests, and an entry in `registry.json`
- [ ] I ran the mod in a real session (`claude --plugin-dir <folder>`)
